description: This file defines a command handler class for creating a savings product in the Apache Fineract project. It is annotated as a service and handles commands of type 'SAVINGSPRODUCT' with action 'CREATE'. The class delegates the creation logic to the 'SavingsProductWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: CreateSavingsProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles creation commands for savings products by delegating to the write platform service.

methods.name: CreateSavingsProductCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the savings product write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to create a new savings product by calling the write platform service.
